description: This file provides platform-specific filesystem utility functions for copying, deleting, and managing directories and files, with implementations for Windows and POSIX systems.

methods.name: fs__dotordotdot
methods.description: Checks if a WCHAR string is '.' or '..'.

methods.name: fs_rmdir_rmdir
methods.description: Recursively removes a directory and its contents on Windows.

methods.name: translate_path
methods.description: Converts a Windows path to a long UNC path format.

methods.name: fs_rmdir_helper
methods.description: Recursively deletes a directory and its contents on Windows.

methods.name: fs_rm_wait
methods.description: Waits until a file or directory is deleted on Windows.

methods.name: fs_rm
methods.description: Deletes a file or directory on Windows.

methods.name: fs_copy
methods.description: Copies files or directories, handling existing destinations.

methods.name: cl_fs_cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up the filesystem, removing temporary files.

methods.name: basename_r
methods.description: Extracts the basename from a path.

methods.name: joinpath
methods.description: Joins directory and filename into a full path.

methods.name: fs_copydir_helper
methods.description: Recursively copies directories on POSIX systems.

methods.name: fs_copyfile_helper
methods.description: Copies a file on POSIX systems, using fcopyfile, sendfile, or manual read/write.
